adapters.name: Node.js / TypeScript
verifierNotes: Use repository package-manager and package scripts when present.

adapters.name: React
verifierNotes: Run browser and accessibility smoke checks after the production build.

adapters.name: Angular
verifierNotes: Use Angular workspace targets discovered from angular.json.

adapters.name: Next.js
verifierNotes: Validate server and client routes plus production rendering.

adapters.name: Vue
verifierNotes: Run component and browser verification.

adapters.name: Svelte / SvelteKit
verifierNotes: Verify SSR and client hydration when enabled.

adapters.name: MERN Stack
verifierNotes: Verify frontend, API, database schema, authentication, and integration tests independently.

adapters.name: n8n Automation
verifierNotes: Import workflows into an isolated instance and verify credentials are references, never embedded secrets.

adapters.name: AWS Cloud
verifierNotes: Resolve account and region at runtime. Deployments require an explicit approval and reviewed change set.

adapters.name: Terraform / OpenTofu
verifierNotes: Apply is critical risk and must never be inferred from a plan request.

adapters.name: Kubernetes
verifierNotes: Discover context and namespace at runtime; mutation requires approval.

adapters.name: Docker / Compose
verifierNotes: Starting or publishing containers requires the selected execution policy.

adapters.name: Salesforce DX
verifierNotes: Target org, source scope, tests, and deployment authorization must be supplied at runtime.

adapters.name: Python
verifierNotes: Prefer environment and commands declared by the project.

adapters.name: Java / JVM
verifierNotes: Select Maven or Gradle from the detected wrapper.

adapters.name: .NET
verifierNotes: Select the application project dynamically in multi-project solutions.

adapters.name: Go
verifierNotes: Use race checks for changed concurrent code.

adapters.name: Rust
verifierNotes: Run clippy and formatting when available.

adapters.name: Mobile Application
verifierNotes: Select platform-specific emulator, signing, and store workflows at runtime.

adapters.name: JavaScript Web Animation
verifierNotes: Verify reduced-motion behavior, frame rate, layout stability, and cleanup of animation timelines.

adapters.name: Motion / Framer Motion
verifierNotes: Verify gesture, transition, reduced-motion, and server-render hydration behavior.

adapters.name: Three.js / WebGL 3D
verifierNotes: Verify WebGL fallback, GPU memory disposal, loading progress, mobile performance, and accessible non-3D alternatives.

adapters.name: Web Components
verifierNotes: Verify shadow DOM styling, events, keyboard behavior, and framework interoperability.
